title: Monitor tribute: Satchmo nickname, Doc Severinsen and Lucille
summary: Murray the K introduces clips including Armstrong explaining the origin of Satchmo, his generosity on stage, and a message to Lucille.

And what you're hearing is sleepy time down south, something you've always heard when he made a public appearance. Louie always loved appearing in public, even when he wasn't scheduled to and wasn't getting paid for it. Doc Severinsen, another pretty fair trumpet player, remembers such an incident.
